conditions.name: Close above prior 20-bar high
conditions.explanation: The current completed close must exceed the previous 20 completed bars' high.

conditions.name: SMA 200 rising over 20 bars
conditions.explanation: Avoids treating a flat or falling long-term average as an uptrend.

conditions.name: RSI 14 above 50
conditions.explanation: Momentum confirmation; not an independent entry trigger.

conditions.name: ADX 14 at least 20
conditions.explanation: Trend-strength filter; ADX does not indicate direction.

conditions.name: Relative volume 20 at least 1
conditions.explanation: Current volume divided by the mean volume of the prior 20 bars.

conditions.name: Close below prior 10-bar low (exit long)
conditions.explanation: SELL means exit an existing long position; this strategy does not initiate short positions.

signals.explanation: 3/7 entry conditions passed. Wait for the complete rule set; no partial score is promoted to BUY.
